title: Geometric composition of normalized twist comparisons
statement: Let $R,S,A,B$ be commutative rings with an $R$-algebra structure on $S$, an $R$-algebra structure on $A$, and an $S$-algebra structure on $B$. Let $A=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}A_n$ and $B=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}B_n$ be graded rings with $A_n$ an $R$-submodule and $B_n$ an $S$-submodule. Fix ring maps $\rho_A:R\to A_0$ and $\rho_B:S\to B_0$ whose composites into $A$ and $B$ are the specified algebra maps. Let $\beta:S\otimes_R A\simeq B$ be an $S$-algebra isomorphism and $\psi:A\to B$ a graded ring map such that $\beta(1\otimes a)=\psi(a)$ and $B_n=\operatorname{span}_S\psi(A_n)$ for every $n$. Write $P=\operatorname{Proj}(A)$, $Q=\operatorname{Proj}(B)$ and use their standard opens and chart inclusions [lem-nagata-affine-proj-scalar-extension], their twisting module sheaves [def-weil-pbc-proj-twisting-sheaf], pullback [def-pc-module-pullback] and tensor product [def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product]. Suppose $r:Q\to P$ satisfies $r^{-1}D_+(f)=D_+(\psi(f))$ for every positive-degree homogeneous $f$, and on this chart is the spectrum map of $A_{(f)}\to B_{(\psi(f))}$ induced by $\psi$. Fix a normalized family $\theta_j:r^*\mathcal O_P(j)\simeq\mathcal O_Q(j)$ [def-sfb-proj-scalar-extension-twist-normalization]. Let $T,C$ be commutative rings with compatible maps $R\to S\to T$, a $T$-algebra structure on $C$, and a nonnegative graded ring structure $C=\bigoplus C_n$ by $T$-submodules. Let $\gamma:T\otimes_S B\simeq C$ be a $T$-algebra isomorphism and $\chi:B\to C$ a graded ring map with $\gamma(1\otimes b)=\chi(b)$ and $C_n=\operatorname{span}_T\chi(B_n)$ for every $n$. Put $Z=\operatorname{Proj}(C)$. Suppose $q:Z\to Q$ and $p:Z\to P$ have on all positive homogeneous standard opens the spectrum maps induced respectively by $\chi$ and $\chi\psi$. Fix normalized families $\eta_j:q^*\mathcal O_Q(j)\simeq\mathcal O_Z(j)$ for $\chi$ and $\zeta_j:p^*\mathcal O_P(j)\simeq\mathcal O_Z(j)$ for $\chi\psi$. For every given equality $h:p=r\circ q$ (written $p=q\mathbin{\gg}r$ in Lean), $\zeta_j$ equals the transport along $h$, followed by the section-normalized pullback-composition isomorphism, $q^*\theta_j$ and $\eta_j$, for every $j\in\mathbf Z$.

proof.text: The normalized adjunction unit is the actual pullback section 1 tensor s. Naturality of the unit identifies pullback of a module morphism on these sections. The unit equation for left-adjoint uniqueness identifies tensorPullbackSectionComp on a pulled section with the iterated pulled section. These are complete private Lean lemmas section_unit, section_naturality and section_comp.

proof.text: The degreewise span conditions imply irrelevant(B) <= map(psi, irrelevant(A)) and similarly for chi, by span induction: positive homogeneous generators map into the ideal, and the ideal is closed under coefficient multiplication. The chart equations and Mathlib Proj.mapAffineOpenCover.hom_ext identify r and q with Proj.map. Mathlib map_preimage_basicOpen then gives the inverse-image formula for every denominator, including those of degree zero. This is proved directly, without applying the affine scalar-extension theorem.

proof.text: For a section s=a/b on U, the theta normalization with coefficient one says theta(1 tensor s) is the fraction psi(a)/psi(b) on r inverse U. The eta normalization therefore says the iterated image multiplied by chi(psi(b)) equals chi(psi(a)). The zeta normalization gives exactly the same equation. The inverse-image formulas show chi(psi(b)) avoids each prime in the composite inverse image of U. Its image in that localization is a unit, so right cancellation equates the two sections. The section-composition and naturality formulas identify the iterated image with the isomorphism in the conclusion.

proof.text: To extend equality from fixed fractions to arbitrary pulled-back sections, use the injectivity of the normalized adjunction Hom equivalence. An adjoint map has source twist(A,j). For an arbitrary source section and a point of the composite inverse image, its built-in locally-fraction predicate supplies a neighborhood with a homogeneous numerator and denominator. Restrict both adjoint maps to that neighborhood; their naturality and equality on the fixed fraction give equality at the chosen point. Pointwise extensionality, module-map extensionality and the Hom equivalence prove equality of the original maps. Isomorphism extensionality finishes. Equality induction on hp supplies precisely the eqToIso transport in the statement. No affine tilde equivalence, quasicoherence assertion, or gluing theorem is used.

theorem scalarExtension_twist_composition_law
    {R S A B : Type u} [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [CommRing B]
    [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A] [Algebra S B]
    (𝒜 : ℕ → Submodule R A) (ℬ : ℕ → Submodule S B)
    [GradedRing 𝒜] [GradedRing ℬ]
    (ρA : R →+* 𝒜 0) (ρB : S →+* ℬ 0)
    (hρA : ∀ a : R, (ρA a : A) = algebraMap R A a)
    (hρB : ∀ b : S, (ρB b : B) = algebraMap S B b)
    (β : TensorProduct R S A ≃ₐ[S] B) (ψ : 𝒜 →+*ᵍ ℬ)
    (hβψ : ∀ a : A, β (TensorProduct.tmul R (1 : S) a) = ψ a)
    (hgraded : ∀ n : ℕ, ℬ n = Submodule.span S (ψ '' (𝒜 n : Set A)))
    (r : Proj ℬ ⟶ Proj 𝒜)
    (hpre : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : A), f ∈ 𝒜 n → 0 < n →
      r ⁻¹ᵁ basicOpen 𝒜 f = basicOpen ℬ (ψ f))
    (hchart : ∀ (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n),
      awayι ℬ (ψ f) (ψ.map_mem hf) hn ≫ r =
        Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map ψ f)) ≫
          awayι 𝒜 f hf hn)
    (θ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback r).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist ℬ j)
    (hθ : IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison ψ r θ) :
    (∀ {T C : Type u} [CommRing T] [CommRing C]
        [Algebra S T] [Algebra R T] [IsScalarTower R S T] [Algebra T C]
        (𝒞 : ℕ → Submodule T C) [GradedRing 𝒞]
        (γ : TensorProduct S T B ≃ₐ[T] C) (χ : ℬ →+*ᵍ 𝒞),
        (∀ b : B, γ (TensorProduct.tmul S (1 : T) b) = χ b) →
        (∀ n : ℕ, 𝒞 n = Submodule.span T (χ '' (ℬ n : Set B))) →
        ∀ (q : Proj 𝒞 ⟶ Proj ℬ) (p : Proj 𝒞 ⟶ Proj 𝒜),
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : B) (hf : f ∈ ℬ n) (hn : 0 < n),
            awayι 𝒞 (χ f) (χ.map_mem hf) hn ≫ q =
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map χ f)) ≫
                awayι ℬ f hf hn) →
          (∀ (n : ℕ) (f : A) (hf : f ∈ 𝒜 n) (hn : 0 < n),
            awayι 𝒞 (χ (ψ f)) ((χ.comp ψ).map_mem hf) hn ≫ p =
              Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom
                (HomogeneousLocalization.Away.map (χ.comp ψ) f)) ≫ awayι 𝒜 f hf hn) →
          ∀ (η : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback q).obj (twist ℬ j) ≅ twist 𝒞 j)
            (ζ : ∀ j : ℤ, (tensorPullback p).obj (twist 𝒜 j) ≅ twist 𝒞 j),
            IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison χ q η →
            IsScalarExtensionTwistComparison (χ.comp ψ) p ζ →
            ∀ hp : p = q ≫ r, ∀ j : ℤ,
              ζ j = eqToIso (congrArg (fun f ↦ (tensorPullback f).obj (twist 𝒜 j)) hp) ≪≫
                (tensorPullbackSectionComp q r).app (twist 𝒜 j) ≪≫
                (tensorPullback q).mapIso (θ j) ≪≫ η j)
